decisions.reason: The existing message-210 MODIFY already updates the About-page prize copy with the applicable 100-sales block, Chainlink VRF selection, and increased chances from more referrals.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already aligns the Mission-page prize and randomness copy with one affiliate selected from each applicable 100-sales block through Chainlink VRF.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already captures the one-ticket-per-referral rule, applicable 100-sale block, Chainlink VRF selection, greater chances from more referrals, and automatic drawing.
Winner selection and automatic draw execution do not change how fiat buyers access wallets, dashboards, tickets, commissions, or delivered prizes.
The source prize-drawing change does not independently alter the claim-flow state, and the same-message event already establishes automatic wallet transfer and removes the obsolete claim URL.
The selection method and draw execution do not change the email-notification behavior, which is already updated by the existing message-210 MODIFY.
The source changes winner selection and draw execution, not secondary royalty amount, enforcement, pool funding, or ticket generation.
The source prize-selection change leaves the existing $5 founder, $5 affiliate, and $5 Small Block pool allocation unchanged.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already incorporates the required $500-every-100-sales and referral-entry messaging; the hero need not enumerate every draw-execution detail.
The Small Block winner-selection change does not alter the amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or destination of coded-referral commissions.
The existing message-210 event already establishes the next-$500-draw sales counter, and the winner-selection method does not require another statistics attribute.
The source changes Small Block winner selection and draw execution but does not change commission allocation for mints without a referral code.
